_readme: Template for a locale glossary. Copy this to <lang>.json — not _template.json, which generate.php cannot load — and fill in every value. The authoritative key list AND the class of every key is classify.json; `php tools/i18n/extract.php --list` prints both. The class shown below is only a comment on the example — when the two disagree, classify.json is right, because it is the file the pipeline reads. generate.php refuses to run against a glossary with a missing or unknown key, so it is safe to start from a partial file and keep running it. The three examples below show what each class wants; delete them. See tools/i18n/README.md.
